class.name: BulletVolleyDebugger2D
class.brief_description: Draws the collision shapes of every [BulletVolley2D]. Created by [BulletFactory2D]; toggle it with [member BulletFactory2D.is_debugger_enabled] and color it with [member BulletFactory2D.debugger_color].
class.description: Draws every bullet collision shape as colored geometry so you can see what the physics server sees. Owned and driven by [BulletFactory2D]; toggle it with the factory debugger properties. True-shape meshes (rectangles, circle fans, capsules) rebuild automatically when a pooled instance is reused with a different shape.
